nav.title: Sental jokkondiral AI
nav.subtitle: Ballal ɗemɗe keewɗe e waylugol e juuɗe neɗɗo.

stats.providerQualificationNote: Ɗemɗe ɗe ndaarndaa seeɗa tan limtee

customer.title: Fuɗɗu yeewtere
customer.consentText: Mi jaɓii wonde yeewtere ndee ina waawi wonde dokkoowo AI. Winndannde ɗee ina suuɗee ado reenaade.
customer.setupHint: Alaa haa gardiiɗo teelti fenaande suuɗgol e dokkoowo AI.
customer.startHint: Sos yeewtere e yardaade ngam fuɗɗaade.
customer.chatEmpty: Ɓeele ina mbaɗi ɗoo. Gollal AI ko wasiya tan; njoɓdi, waylugol konte walla neldugol huunde novii.
customer.voiceStreamNote: Daande wanngorde ina neldee to dokkoowo oo; OpsCore wi'ataa wonde ina reena daande aduna.
customer.voiceRequirement: Daande wanngorde ina wasa HTTPS, maaykiro, yardaade, model Realtime e fenaande dokkoowo. Wonaa jokkondiral telefoŋ.

queue.title: Rewoowo waylugol
queue.description: Yeewtere ɗe caɗeele, ɗe ndokkaani jaabawol walla ɗe ñaŋnii neɗɗo ina mbaɗi ɗoo. Rewoowo firti ko ñaŋnaama, wonaa jokkondiral.
queue.empty: Waylugol yimɓe alaa e nder fedde ndee.
queue.replyStorageNote: Jaabawol yimɓe ina suuɗee, ina feeñi e winndannde yeewtere ndee.

boundaries.title: Keeri golle
boundaries.automateBody: Jaabawol aranol e ɗemɗe keewɗe, ɓeydude laaɓal, ƴeewndo baɗal, reenaade winndannde kisɗunde e newaade gollotooɓe.
boundaries.humanTitle: Waylugol e juuɗe neɗɗo ina wasa
boundaries.humanBody: Ñaŋgol neɗɗo, hoolaare famɗunde, baɗal mawngal, laawol alaa, fiyaaku mo jaabaani, wiyoowo e suturo walla baɗal anndaaka.
boundaries.notEnabledTitle: Alaa e nder ndee package tan
boundaries.notEnabledBody: Telefoŋ/PSTN, WhatsApp, email, jokkondiral daande, woodgol e CRM e hoolaare ko ɗemɗe ina wasa dokkoowo goonga, fenaande e jarribooji jaɓgol.

messages.qualificationNotice: Ɗemngal alaa jaɓgol haa jarribooji binndol, ASR, TTS e waylugol ndokka.
messages.configOk: Sifaa ina woodi. Jokkondiral dokkoowo e hoolaare ɗemngal ina wasa jarribooji goonga.
messages.conversationCreated: Yeewtere kisɗunde sosaa. Hoolaare ɗemngal jaɓaani.
messages.handoffQueued: Waylugol e neɗɗo ina e rewoowo ({reason}). Ko ñaŋgol rewoowo, wonaa jokkondiral jooni.
messages.aiResponseFailed: Jaabawol AI timmaani. Gollal alaa. A waawi ñaŋnude neɗɗo.
messages.apiUnavailable: API sental jokkondiral loowaani. Naatu e konsol OpsCore, ndeen loowto ngoo hello.
messages.handoffQueuedQueueOnly: Waylugol e neɗɗo ina e rewoowo ({reason}). Rewoowo hollataa wonde gollotooɗo ina jokkondiri.
messages.voiceHandoffStopped: Waylugol e neɗɗo ina e rewoowo. Yeewtere AI ina darii; waylugol telefoŋ teeltinaani.
messages.voiceRealtimeError: Dokkoowo Realtime holliima goɗɗum. Dartin yeewtere daande, ƴeew sifaa, ndeen eto kadi.
messages.voiceActive: Yeewtere daande ina golla. Ñaŋnu neɗɗo saanga kala; ɗum sosata ko rewoowo, wonaa waylugol telefoŋ.

errors.CONTACT_CENTER_CONSENT_REQUIRED: Yardaade ina wasa ado yeewtere fuɗɗaade.
